zh: 对非负整数，反复取 x % 10 得到最低位、再整除 10 去掉这一位，就能从低到高拿到所有十进制数字。
数字是倒着得到的，最后反转；负数先记下符号再对绝对值处理，0 要单独输出 "0"。
每行读一个整数（跳过空行）。用 64 位整数保存绝对值，这样 −2147483648 取反也不会溢出。逐位取模生成字符，补上负号后反转输出，每个整数一行。
en: For a non-negative integer, x % 10 gives the lowest digit and dividing by 10 removes it, so repeating this yields all decimal digits from lowest to highest.
The digits come out reversed, so reverse them at the end; for a negative number remember the sign and work on the absolute value; 0 must be printed as "0" separately.

Read one integer per line (skip blank lines). Keep the absolute value in a 64-bit integer so negating −2147483648 cannot overflow. Build the characters digit by digit, add the minus sign, reverse, and print one integer per line.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Repeatedly take the last digit of the absolute value and divide by 10, join the digits in reverse order, and add a minus sign when needed. 0 is handled separately. To cover INT_MIN, use an integer representation that does not overflow.

## Proof of correctness

Each modulo step yields exactly the current lowest decimal digit, and integer division by 10 removes that digit; reversing all the digits restores the original order and sign, so the resulting characters match the decimal representation digit by digit.

## Complexity

Let D be the total number of decimal digits: O(D) time and O(D) space apart from the output.

## Source note

The upstream original problem forbids the built-in conversion helper; this site's judge can only check the output and cannot statically prove that a contestant did not call a built-in conversion function.

This site separately prepared the standard input/output protocol; it does not claim the original site provides it.
